description: Reserved by the Institute of Chartered Accountants
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard for Small and Medium-sized Entities (SLFRS for SMEs) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements for accounting standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
